glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 水 (“water”) + phonetic 𠬛.
senses: [méi] not have; there is not; to be without
[méi] to be not so... as (when comparing)
[mò] to drown; to sink; to submerge; to inundate; to overwhelm
[mò] to rise beyond; to cover; to overflow
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 沒; s_page_origin explains the simplified 没.
